description: Read public Facebook data with Desearch. Set action and that action's arguments. search (query; optional count, cursor) and hashtag (tag; optional count, cursor) return Meta Ad Library ads that match, not organic posts. post (id): one public post. profile (profile_id): a page or profile by ID or public handle. profile_posts (profile_id; optional count, cursor): its posts. comments (post_id; optional count, cursor): a post's comments, about 10 per page. post and profile return the item itself. List actions return { results, next_cursor, next }. For the next page, call again with the same action and target and cursor set to next_cursor, unchanged; next_cursor is null on the last page. A cursor lasts 24 hours.

count.description: Most items to return (1-100). API default: 10 for search, 20 for the other list actions. One page may hold fewer.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same action and target, sent back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

id.description: post: the public Facebook post or media ID.

post_id.description: comments: the public Facebook post or media ID.

profile_id.description: profile, profile_posts: page or profile ID, or its public handle, example: 'facebook'.

query.description: search: keyword or phrase, example: 'running shoes'.

tag.description: hashtag: the hashtag without #, example: 'ai'. A leading # is removed.

name: facebook
title: Facebook
